contracts: (Exact Cover validation accepts the complete mapping and the isolated orphan fixture is deterministically blocked.) AND (exact-cover validation 报告每个 Atomic Obligation 和每个 command node 均具有相反方向的有效覆盖，且无孤儿。) AND (结果为 conformant，且每个 Atomic Obligation 有 assertion 覆盖、每个 assertion 节点有对应的反向 Atomic Obligation 覆盖。)
selector_intents: Run the existing exact-cover negative validator with its isolated reverse-mapping orphan fixture and require its deliberate nonzero outcome.
以现有负例移除 assertion 的反向 Atomic Obligation 绑定，验证器必须以 wrong_binding 阻断。
向 exact-cover negative validator 提供一个缺少 command-to-Atomic-Obligation 反向覆盖的关系。
